customer_message: Our admin team lost access after the SSO certificate rotation and we need to restore login for the finance group today.
account_context: Enterprise tenant. Recent certificate rotation completed 3 hours ago. Tenant-wide access impact confirmed by account notes.
source_pack: Policy excerpt: Tenant-wide identity incidents require specialist review before any irreversible authentication change. Policy excerpt: Identity verification must be completed with the requesting admin before account recovery actions are taken. Guidance: acknowledge urgency, avoid promising immediate restoration, and hand off with the exact verification checkpoint.
